source_findings.acceleration_sign: UNKNOWN_CSV_PROCESSING; manufacturer SDK documentation does not establish author CSV transformation

source_findings.upstream_processing: No CSV-generation/IMU-transform implementation in reviewed local author repository; paper processing section describes camera/UWB calibration, not IMU transformation

source_findings.anchors: v2 identity layout, all 8 radio IDs; no v1 GT-derived ID mapping required
